scientific_integrity: An analytic all-parameter proof uses a uniquely minimized trigonometric quotient and strict convexity/concavity. The accompanying reproducible finite checker is supplementary, not an infinite theorem certificate. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only fixed points and local one-dimensional multipliers, not all periodic orbits, entropy, invariant measures, chaoticity or global basins. Parameters lie strictly in the open unit cube. Priority remains subject to an uninspected related 2024 full text.
title: Exact dual fold surfaces and two-sink coexistence in a cosine interval map
